description: Language acquisition (Japanese, Mandarin, Russian). Repetition + comprehensible-input > theory.

frontier_definition.currency_signal: current native register / slang / register shifts / recent media
frontier_definition.prompt_anchor: Frontier = current native usage in last 12 months — slang shifts, register changes, what natives actually say in 2025-2026, not textbook usage.

phases.label: Sound + script
phases.tone: produce + distinguish phonemes; map to script

phases.label: High-frequency
phases.tone: top 200-500 words + the grammar that ties them; hyper-personal sentences

phases.label: Patterns
phases.tone: the 12-15 sentence frames that compose 80% of daily speech

phases.label: Native register
phases.tone: current slang / register shifts / dialects; recent media

phases.label: Synthesis
phases.tone: produce a sustained monologue or dialogue with a real native speaker
